callees.name: _remove_trailing_commas
callees.pre_condition: text is a string from which JSONC comment syntax has already been removed.
callees.post_condition: Returns a string in which every comma that immediately precedes a closing bracket ']' or closing brace '}' (with only optional whitespace between the comma and the closing character) has been removed. All other characters, whitespace, and structure are preserved unchanged.
